original_idea.body: Replicate the Rogue Scalpel random-vector-averaging universal jailbreak on a different open chat model, measuring harmful-compliance lift on held-out requests and how many averaged vectors are needed.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: replicating a cheap universal-jailbreak steering attack maps a serious adversarial-robustness gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Random-vector averaging + compliance measurement; guided red-team replication.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Red-team replication on open models, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Direct replication of the Rogue Scalpel attack; largely addressed.
